title: Academic Integrity and Responsible AI in Biology English
objective: Students learn honest academic behavior before summarizing and analyzing biology texts.
outcomes: Use quotation, paraphrase, and citation appropriately.
Write a simple AI disclosure statement.
Respect other people’s ideas in discussion.
activity: Case study: decide whether five examples are honest writing, weak paraphrasing, or plagiarism.
example: If a student uses AI to improve grammar, they can write: “AI was used to check grammar and clarity. The scientific ideas are my own.”
